questions.question: How many drug overdose deaths were recorded in Alabama in 2016 for all demographic groups combined?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_drug_poisoning_mortality_state.csv')
val = df[(df['State'] == 'Alabama') & (df['Year'] == 2016) & (df['Sex'] == 'Both Sexes') & (df['Age Group'] == 'All Ages') & (df['Race and Hispanic Origin'] == 'All Races-All Origins')]['Deaths'].iloc[0]
result = int(val)

questions.question: In 2012, which state had a higher age-adjusted mortality rate from drug poisoning: Alabama or Alaska?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_drug_poisoning_mortality_state.csv')
al_rate = df[(df['State'] == 'Alabama') & (df['Year'] == 2012) & (df['Sex'] == 'Both Sexes') & (df['Age Group'] == 'All Ages') & (df['Race and Hispanic Origin'] == 'All Races-All Origins')]['Age-adjusted Rate'].iloc[0]
ak_rate = df[(df['State'] == 'Alaska') & (df['Year'] == 2012) & (df['Sex'] == 'Both Sexes') & (df['Age Group'] == 'All Ages') & (df['Race and Hispanic Origin'] == 'All Races-All Origins')]['Age-adjusted Rate'].iloc[0]
result = 'Alabama' if al_rate > ak_rate else 'Alaska'

questions.question: Did the national crude drug poisoning mortality rate exceed 15 deaths per 100,000 in 2014?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_drug_poisoning_mortality_state.csv')
rate = df[df['Year'] == 2014]['US Crude Rate'].iloc[0]

questions.question: Between 2008 and 2016, which year saw the highest crude drug overdose death rate in Alaska?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_drug_poisoning_mortality_state.csv')
ak = df[(df['State'] == 'Alaska') & (df['Year'] >= 2008) & (df['Year'] <= 2016) & (df['Sex'] == 'Both Sexes') & (df['Age Group'] == 'All Ages') & (df['Race and Hispanic Origin'] == 'All Races-All Origins')]
year = ak.loc[ak['Crude Death Rate'].idxmax()]['Year']
result = str(year)

questions.question: How many total drug poisoning fatalities occurred in Wyoming across the three-year span from 2014 through 2016?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_drug_poisoning_mortality_state.csv')
sub = df[(df['State'] == 'Wyoming') & (df['Year'].isin([2014, 2015, 2016])) & (df['Sex'] == 'Both Sexes') & (df['Age Group'] == 'All Ages') & (df['Race and Hispanic Origin'] == 'All Races-All Origins')]
result = int(sub['Deaths'].sum())
